order: Record the final gate verdict for the delta-review track once it returns a clean approve with exactly zero findings, and update the review dispositions file so the two prior tracks this review had been holding in a needs-revision state are marked closed. The verdict file must show, in a compact form, the trajectory across all nine delta rounds that brought this review down from eleven major findings to zero — cite the round-by-round history verbatim, never only the final number. Every fix folded into this verdict must trace to an owner ruling already on record; nothing may be adjudicated fresh inside the verdict file itself. Update the older dispositions document only for the two tracks this review was blocking — leave every other track's disposition text unchanged — and carry forward the two items already flagged as non-blocking follow-ons rather than dropping them or promoting them to blockers.
claims: Recorded the approve verdict with zero findings and updated the dispositions file so both blocked tracks are marked closed: 2 files changed, 55 insertions, 11 deletions. Nine delta rounds brought the review down from eleven major findings to zero, each round's verdict recorded verbatim in the record; two independent review paths converged on the same issues twice along the way. Two items are logged as non-blocking follow-ons: the diff-derived touches check and the reference runner's force-sweep behavior.
